dimensions.details: Split isolation (1.48M/185k/185k) verified; zero data leakage across train/val/test splits.
Zero prohibited target, screen, document, or prediction metadata fields in feature vector.
183 features across 13 feature groups demonstrate 100% geometric and structural coverage.
Minority class F1 improved by +77.0% across sidebar, stack, centered, other.
Strong F1 scores (>= 96%) achieved across all 8 layout target classes.
Stable performance across RICO, WebCode2M, WebUI (Mean: 97.4%, StdDev: 0.0051).
Feature, class, and viewport distributions are stable across train, val, and test splits.
Mean prediction confidence is 96.5% with low high-confidence error rate.
Held-out test error rate is low (2.5%), addressing Phase 19.5 minority class failure modes.
